mode: report_only; source-code and saved-artifact review; no new data, network, or market effect run
scope: P1 fixed-600 momentum selection, P2 independent profitability, and the P3 parallel selection/value lane; main repository native workflow read only
plain_answer: 已有股票研究确实逐股排序并保存逐股结果，不能说只看平均曲线。原生六阶段入口对其受支持的特征有硬性预算和重复运行检查，但尚不能执行这两个股票月度选择算法；本轮靠各自冻结脚本和主控回执维持边界。下一条价值研究需要一个很小的专用运行前后核验层，而非新研究平台。

selection_vs_average_curve.P1: Sufficient to show the direct momentum ranking is not merely a whole-pool average curve: 600x132 preserved stock rows, monthly chosen lists and equal-pool comparison; five same-date momentum rank groups were reported (0.9734%,1.1191%,1.2149%,1.1933%,0.9736% monthly from strongest to weakest), without monotone selection signal. The nine-cell conditioned result is a separate question, not a positive proof for direct momentum. Evidence: lowfreq-expanded-discovery-2026-10-19.md:7-30,48-64,129-133; lowfreq_discovery.py:219-267,619-640.
selection_vs_average_curve.P2: Sufficient to show an actual stock-selection comparison, not just a mean financial curve: same month/industry/pool, saved financial and momentum percentiles and per-stock P/M/F/B/D target weights, plus 132-month and era/annual paired outcomes. It does not yet display the full within-date financial-score rank gradient; GP/common monthly qualified pools shrink to 142-329 and tiny sectors all-hold. Evidence: lowfreq-profitability-increment-2026-10-19.md:15-16,33-59,116-140; evaluate_profitability.py:206-238,480-531.
selection_vs_average_curve.single_necessary_diagnostic_if_selection: Use the already saved P2 stock_weights.csv with its manifest hash. First derive bands from a projection containing only month/code/industry/financial_percentile and source eligibility: within each industry with at least five qualified stocks, split the frozen score order into five stable (score,code) bands with remainder-first sizes, recording tied-score and tiny-sector/constant-score mass. Only after the band assignment is frozen, join the saved future_return/either_halt columns. Preserve original industry n/N mass; report each band’s outcome and top-minus-bottom monthly paired difference under both existing unknown-result scenarios, 2015-2019 versus 2020-2025 and yearly support. Reconcile rows/weights to the saved P/M/F/B/D outputs; no new source fetch, parameter choice, rerun of old momentum/core or claim of independent confirmation. If tiny/constant bands dominate, mark gradient not evaluable rather than change band count.

minimum_tool_patch.judgment: A task-local lowfreq_research_control.py is justified for the next P3 contract because native workflow has no adapter for source-timed stock valuation/selection and three operational checks remain manual. It should be a guard around existing contracts and manifests, not a new experiment engine, ledger, or shared-workflow modification.
scope: read-only preflight: exact design/runner/source/price/cohort hash lineage and at-decision qualification matrix; distinguish terminal source gaps from an acquisition/preparation attempt still pending; reject outcome columns in selector/proposal phase

read-only attempt check: compare existing P1/P2/P3 briefs, contracts, manifests and receipts for identical source/question/run identity, cumulative budget and any unsettled attempt; no inferred fresh budget on filename change

post-run acceptance: output create-only external identity plus expected files/hash, 600x132 preservation or explicit P3 defined support, all pending/failed states retained, conclusion status never inferred from process exit
acceptance: A current value quote with publication after decision is rejected while an explicitly unknown source stays unknown.
A selector projection containing future_return is rejected before selecting any cutoff; evaluation phase may read it only under the frozen selector contract.
An existing start without terminal receipt blocks a second effect run, and a completed identical run reports reuse rather than recomputation.
Changing output name, agent, or factor label leaves cumulative recorded core/follow-up counts unchanged.
The guard accepts the already sealed P1/P2 manifests as historical references without altering them and reports the native workflow as not applicable for these adapters.
non_goals: No edits to question_contract.py, workflow.py, native ledger or another owner’s scripts in this audit.
No new data collection, return calculation, parameter grid, production decision or claim that program checks can establish financial mechanism truth.
